from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from pypdf.generic import NameObject, ArrayObject, NumberObject, StreamObject, IndirectObject

r = PdfReader('permit-form.pdf')
w = PdfWriter()
w.append(r)
p = w.pages[0]
vals = {'organizer':'Tidewater Studio','event_date':'2026-12-05','location':'North Cove Lawn','attendees':'about 40'}
w.update_page_form_field_values(p, vals, auto_regenerate=False)

annots = p.get('/Annots')
draws = []
for a in annots:
    o = a.get_object()
    t = o.get('/T')
    if t is None: continue
    name = str(t)
    if name not in vals: continue
    rect = o.get('/Rect')
    x0,y0,x1,y1 = [float(v) for v in rect]
    text = vals[name].replace('(','\\\\(').replace(')','\\\\)')
    draws.append(f'BT /F1 11 Tf {x0+2:.1f} {y0+2:.1f} Td ({text}) Tj ET')
content = ('\n'.join(draws)).encode('latin-1')

# combine existing content + new draws into one stream
existing = p.get_contents()
existing_data = existing.get_data() if existing is not None else b''
new = existing_data + b'\n' + content

# make a fresh stream object
s = StreamObject()
s.set_data(new)
p[NameObject('/Contents')] = w._add_object(s)

root = w._root_object
if '/AcroForm' in root:
    del root[NameObject('/AcroForm')]
if '/Annots' in p:
    del p[NameObject('/Annots')]
